thread:
alex: Heads-up: noticed an ambiguity in quota resolution when org + key + plan (and add-ons) are all present. Who wins? Also how should the Console surface the "effective" limit so customers aren't surprised?

maria: I thought we did per-key override > per-org > plan default. But bursts are special — they sometimes layer.

kevin: yep that's what lookup_service does today: checks key_entitlement -> org_entitlement -> plan_defaults. It treats burst windows as override unless flagged to merge.

alex: Proposal: treat hard limits as exclusive (override) but allow an `inherit_burst` flag on per-key to opt into additive burst allowances from org. That gives customers control and predictable billing.

sam: edge case: shared API keys across multiple orgs and enterprise metered add-ons. We need clear precedence for add-ons (do they stack or replace?).

maria: quick proposal for resolution order: 1) explicit per-key hard_limit (take precedence) 2) additive bursts (if inherit_burst set, merge org bursts) 3) plan-level soft_limits 4) enterprise add-ons applied after base limits (can increase capacity).

kevin: pseudocode for lookup we can add to the RFC:
```
def resolve_quota(key, org, plan, addons):
  if key.hard_limit: return key.hard_limit, source="per-key"
  effective_burst = key.burst if not key.inherit_burst else merge(key.burst, org.burst)
  base_limit = org.limit or plan.default_limit
  final_limit = apply_addons(base_limit, addons)
  return {limit: final_limit, burst: effective_burst, source_breakdown: [...] }
```

ops-bot: Deployment #456 rolled out to staging (quota-resolution-v2 feature flag enabled for 10% of orgs).

zoe: UX: Console should show an "effective limit" number plus a compact breakdown: which rule provided the number (per-key/org/plan/add-on) and a hover to expand merge logic. Also show a small timeline when rule last changed.

sam: Also surface `X-Quota-Source` header in API responses so integrators can programmatically know which rule applied.

alex: If people agree i'll open an RFC and a migration plan. I'll add metrics for `quota_conflicts_detected` and `merged_burst_count` to measure impact.

maria: :thumbsup: please gate behavior behind `quota-resolution-v2` flag and include an operator-visible toggle in Console.

kevin: I'll update lookup_service, add unit tests, and wire the feature flag toggles. Will also emit the source breakdown in `/v1/usage` response.

alex: Thanks all — leaving this thread open for any final concerns. ping @product for copy/console wording.
